title: Pink Cotton Candy Tree
body:
Description

The Pink Cotton Candy Tree spawns on the Finlay Island in the Flowering Meadows. They are worth more than their counterpart, the Blue Cotton Candy Tree.

Textures

The various textures of the Pink Cotton Candy Tree in its raw, sanded, and planked states.

Trivia

  • Cotton Candy trees are very light and are smaller at the base.
  • Although hard to see, the logs have a cardboard texture to mimic a cotton candy stick.
